rule_or_pattern: drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out (label length far off the crop width: crop shows a different line) OR C:repeated_word (Google doubled words: 'Λιβύης Λιβύης', 'Συήνης Συήνης', 'καὶ καὶ δύο δύο τῆς τῆς')
notes: A two-column 1927 polytonic study with a Greek-French gazetteer. The French and Greek dictionary lines (15-18, 27, 28, 30, 33, 38, 39) are read correctly, so the language flag is genre. A describable bad subset exists. Lines 21, 25, 29 and 32 are crop/label mismatches: 29's crop shows 'τὰ ἀληθῶς... διευκρινοῦσι κατ᾿ ἀλήθειαν τὰ πράγματα καὶ μαρτυροῦσαι' but is labelled 'μαρτιροίσαι'; 32's crop shows '...Ἀδουλίτας τῆς σημερινῆς Ἐρυθραίας, ἔχοντας σημαντικὰ' but is labelled 'Οὗτοι καὶ οἱ παρὰ'. Lines 24, 35 and 37 double words that appear once in print. These carry cpp_vs_book_out or repeated_word. A few minor slips remain outside the rule (10 adds 'αν.', 11 is truncated), and 26 is a gutter merge for the pool rule.
